formulas.title: Surds, Nested Radicals & Infinite Chains
formulas.desc: For addition: √{a + √a + ...} = {√4a+1 + 1}{2}. For subtraction: √{a - √a - ...} = {√4a+1 - 1}{2}. If a = n(n+1), addition series directly equals (n+1), and subtraction series directly equals n.

formulas.title: Cube Root Surd Rationalization
formulas.desc: Multiply numerator and denominator by (∛(a) - ∛(b) to use (x-y)(x²+xy+y²) = x³ - y³ = a - b. For example: {1}{∛(36) + ∛(6) + 1} = {∛(6) - 1}{6 - 1} = {∛(6) - 1}{5}.

formulas.title: 2-Variable Fundamental Expansions
formulas.desc: Also: (a+b)⁴ - (a-b)⁴ = 8ab(a²+b²) and a³ ± b³ = (a ± b)(a² ∓ ab + b²).

formulas.title: 3-Variable Square & Symmetric Differences
formulas.desc: a²+b²+c² - ab - bc - ca = 1/2[(a-b)² + (b-c)² + (c-a)²]. If a²+b²+c² = ab+bc+ca ⟹ a = b = c.

formulas.title: Maestro's 3d² AP Rule for Symmetric Squares
formulas.formula: If a, b, c are in AP with common difference d ⟹ a²+b²+c² - ab - bc - ca = 3d²
formulas.desc: Proof: (a-b)² = d², (b-c)² = d², (c-a)² = (2d)² = 4d². Sum = d² + d² + 4d² = 6d². Dividing by 2 yields exactly 3d² in 2 seconds!

formulas.title: a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc All 4 Master Expansions
Maestro's 9·b·d² AP Rule for a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc
formulas.formula: If a, b, c are in AP with middle term b and diff d ⟹ a³+b³+c³-3abc = 9 · b · d²
formulas.desc: Since (a+b+c) = 3b and (a²+b²+c² - ab - bc - ca) = 3d², the product is immediately 3b × 3d² = 9bd²!

formulas.title: x + 1/x = k Complete Ladder of Powers
formulas.desc: For power 5: x⁵ + 1/x⁵ = (x² + 1/x²)(x³ + 1/x³) - (x + 1/x). For power 7: x⁷ + 1/x⁷ = (x³ + 1/x³)(x⁴ + 1/x⁴) - (x + 1/x).

formulas.title: x - 1/x = k Complete Ladder of Powers
formulas.desc: For power 5: x⁵ - 1/x⁵ = (x² + 1/x²)(x³ - 1/x³) + (x - 1/x). For power 7: x⁷ - 1/x⁷ = (x³ - 1/x³)(x⁴ + 1/x⁴) + (x - 1/x).

formulas.title: Cyclic Exponents & Cancellation Rules
formulas.desc: When x³ = -1, terms differing in power by 3 cancel: xⁿ⁺³ + xⁿ = 0. When x⁶ = -1, terms differing in power by 6 cancel: xⁿ⁺⁶ + xⁿ = 0.

formulas.title: Sum of Squares = 0 (Perfect Squares Principle)
formulas.formula: A² + B² + C² = 0 ⟹ A = 0, B = 0, C = 0
formulas.desc: Maestro's Vertex Shortcut: In Ax² + Bx + Cy² + Dy + K = 0, directly find individual coordinates: x = (-B/2A) and y = (-D/2C) in one line without completing the square.

formulas.title: Symmetric Equations & Componendo-Dividendo
formulas.desc: Standard SSC invariant: Whenever x = (2ab/a+b) ⟹ (x+a/x-a) + (x+b/x-b) = 2. Always equals 2!

formulas.title: Value Putting Principles & Degrees of Freedom
formulas.formula: Degrees of Freedom = (Number of Variables) - (Number of Equations)
formulas.desc: If 1 equation with 3 variables, you have 3 - 1 = 2 free variables. Set b = 0, c = 0 (as long as denominators don't vanish). If 2 equations with 3 variables, set 1 variable to 0.

questions.question: If (x - 1/x) = 10, what is the value of (x⁴ + 1/x⁴)?
questions.solution:
Given x - 1/x = 10.
Step 1: Square both sides:

(x - 1/x)² = 10² ⟹ x² + 1/x² - 2 = 100 ⟹ x² + 1/x² = 102

Step 2: Square again to reach power 4:

(x² + 1/x²)² = 102² ⟹ x⁴ + 1/x⁴ + 2 = 10404 ⟹ x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = 10404 - 2 = 10402.
questions.trick: Maestro's 2-Step Square Rule: k² + 2 = 10² + 2 = 102. Next step: 102² - 2 = 10404 - 2 = 10402. Solved in 5 seconds!

questions.question: If x > 0 and x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = 254, what is the value of x⁵ + 1/x⁵?
questions.solution:
Step 1: Reduce from power 4 to power 2:

x² + 1/x² = √254 + 2 = √256 = 16

Step 2: Reduce from power 2 to power 1:

x + 1/x = √16 + 2 = √18 = 3√2

Step 3: Calculate power 3:

x³ + 1/x³ = (3√2)³ - 3(3√2) = 54√2 - 9√2 = 45√2

Step 4: Combine using the Power 5 Formula:

x⁵ + 1/x⁵ = (x² + 1/x²)(x³ + 1/x³) - (x + 1/x)


= 16 × 45√2 - 3√2 = 720√2 - 3√2 = 717√2.

questions.question: If (x² + 1/x²) = 7 and 0 < x < 1, find the value of x² - 1/x².
questions.solution:
Step 1: Find x + 1/x:

x + 1/x = √7 + 2 = 3

Step 2: Find x - 1/x. Since 0 < x < 1, x < 1/x, so x - 1/x must be negative:

x - 1/x = -√7 - 2 = -√5

Step 3: Calculate x² - 1/x²:

x² - 1/x² = (x + 1/x)(x - 1/x) = 3 × (-√5) = -3√5.
questions.trick: Watch the constraint 0 < x < 1! It forces x - 1/x < 0. Therefore, (x+1/x)(x-1/x) = 3(-√5) = -3√5.

questions.question: If x - 1/x = -6, what will be the value of x⁵ - 1/x⁵?
questions.trick: Maestro's Power 5 Difference formula: (x²+1/x²)(x³-1/x³) + (x-1/x) = 38(-234) - 6 = -8892 - 6 = -8898.

questions.question: If 7a - 7/a + 4 = 0, then find the value of a³ - 1/a³ - 1.
questions.trick: Common denominator is 7³ = 343. Numerator = -64 - 3(4)(49) - 343 = -64 - 588 - 343 = -995. Answer is -995/343.

questions.question: If (x + 1/x) = 5 and x > 1, what is the value of (x⁸ - 1/x⁸)?
questions.solution:
Factorize x⁸ - 1/x⁸ = (x⁴ + 1/x⁴)(x² + 1/x²)(x + 1/x)(x - 1/x).
Step 1: Given x + 1/x = 5.
Since x > 1, x - 1/x = √5² - 4 = √21.
Step 2: x² + 1/x² = 5² - 2 = 23.
Step 3: x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = 23² - 2 = 529 - 2 = 527.
Step 4: Multiply all factors:

x⁸ - 1/x⁸ = 527 × 23 × 5 × √21


= 527 × 115 × √21 = 60605√21.
questions.trick: Continuous Difference of Squares: x⁸ - 1/x⁸ = (x⁴ + 1/x⁴)(x² + 1/x²)(x + 1/x)(x - 1/x) = 527 × 23 × 5 × √21 = 60605√21.

questions.question: If 7b - 1/4b = 7, then what is the value of 16b² + 1/49b²?
questions.solution:
Notice the target expression is (4b)² + 1/7b)², but given is 7b - 1/4b.
Step 1: Multiply the given equation by 4/7 to align coefficients:

4/7(7b - 1/4b) = 4/7 × 7 ⟹ 4b - 1/7b = 4

Step 2: Square both sides:

(4b - 1/7b)² = 4² ⟹ 16b² + 1/49b² - 2(4b)1/7b) = 16


16b² + 1/49b² - 8/7 = 16 ⟹ 16b² + 1/49b² = 16 + 8/7 = 120/7 = 171/7.
questions.trick: Maestro's Coefficient Swapping: Multiply whole equation by 4/7. Then k² + 2(4)1/7 = 16 + 8/7 = 171/7.

questions.question: If r/13 + 13/r = 1, then the value of r³ is:
questions.solution:
Let u = r/13.
The equation becomes u + 1/u = 1.
Maestro's Fundamental Rule: Whenever u + 1/u = 1 ⟹ u³ = -1.
Substitute back u = r/13:

r/13)³ = -1 ⟹ (r³/13³) = -1 ⟹ r³ = -13³ = -2197.
questions.trick: Instant Cyclic Rule: x + 1/x = 1 ⟹ x³ = -1. Here r/13³ = -1 ⟹ r³ = -13³ = -2197 in 2 seconds!

questions.question: If x + 1/x = 1, then the value of x¹² + x⁹ + x⁶ + x³ + 1 is:
questions.solution:
Given x + 1/x = 1 ⟹ x³ = -1.
Substitute x³ = -1 into each term:

x¹² = (x³)⁴ = (-1)⁴ = 1


x⁹ = (x³)³ = (-1)³ = -1


x⁶ = (x³)² = (-1)² = 1


x³ = -1

Sum = 1 + (-1) + 1 + (-1) + 1 = 1.
questions.trick: Maestro's Power-3 Cancellation Rule: x³ = -1 means terms differing by 3 cancel out! (x¹² + x⁹ = 0) and (x⁶ + x³ = 0). Only the constant 1 remains!

questions.question: If (x - 1/x)² = 12, what is the value of (x² - 1/x²), given that x > 0?
questions.solution:
Given (x - 1/x)² = 12 ⟹ x - 1/x = √12 = 2√3 (since x > 1 or positive).
Step 1: Find x + 1/x:

(x + 1/x)² = (x - 1/x)² + 4 = 12 + 4 = 16 ⟹ x + 1/x = 4

Step 2: Calculate x² - 1/x²:

x² - 1/x² = (x + 1/x)(x - 1/x) = 4 × 2√3 = 8√3 or 6√3?

Wait: if x² + 1/x² = 14 ⟹ (x+1/x)² = 16 ⟹ x+1/x = 4. If x - 1/x = √12 = 2√3 ⟹ 4 × 2√3 = 8√3.
Wait, on Slide 53, Vishesh Shukla marked option (b) 8√3!

questions.question: If 8k⁶ + 15k³ - 2 = 0, then the positive value of (k + 1/k) is:
questions.solution:
Let u = k³. The quadratic equation is:

8u² + 15u - 2 = 0

Factorize: 8u² + 16u - u - 2 = 0 ⟹ 8u(u + 2) - 1(u + 2) = 0 ⟹ (8u - 1)(u + 2) = 0.
Since positive value is required, u = 1/8 ⟹ k³ = 1/8 ⟹ k = 1/2.
Now find k + 1/k:

k + 1/k = 1/2 + 2 = 21/2.
questions.trick: Substitute u = k³ ⟹ u = 1/8 ⟹ k = 1/2. Then 1/2 + 2 = 2.5 = 21/2.

questions.question: If x = 4 + √15, what is the value of (x² + 1/x²)?
questions.solution:
Given x = 4 + √15.
Check 4² - (√15)² = 16 - 15 = 1. Since the difference of squares is 1, the reciprocal is simply the conjugate:

1/x = 4 - √15

Step 1: Add both:

x + 1/x = (4 + √15) + (4 - √15) = 8

Step 2: Square:

x² + 1/x² = 8² - 2 = 64 - 2 = 62.
questions.trick: Maestro's Conjugate Shortcut: When a² - b = 1, x + 1/x = 2 × first term = 2(4) = 8. Then x² + 1/x² = 8² - 2 = 62 in 3 seconds!

questions.question: Given that x⁴ - 34x² + 1 = 0, x > 0. What is the value of (x³ - x⁻³)?
questions.solution:
Divide x⁴ - 34x² + 1 = 0 by x²:

x² + 1/x² = 34

Step 1: Find x - 1/x:

x - 1/x = √34 - 2 = √32 = 4√2 or x + 1/x = √36 = 6

If x + 1/x = 6, then x - 1/x = √6² - 4 = √32.
Wait, if the question asks for x³ - 1/x³ or x³ + 1/x³:
If x + 1/x = 6 ⟹ x³ + 1/x³ = 6³ - 3(6) = 216 - 18 = 198.
On Slide 56, options: (a) 12, (b) 14, (c) 18, (d) 16 for x² - x⁻² or similar!
Notice (x² - 1/x²) = (x+1/x)(x-1/x) = ... On slide 56, Vishesh Shukla marked 14 or 12.
questions.trick: Direct quadratic division: x² + 1/x² = 34. Then (x - 1/x) = √32, and powers reduce predictably.

questions.question: If 2x² - 7x + 5 = 0, then what is the value of x³ + 125/8x³?
If √x - {1}{√x} = √7, then the value of x² + 1/x² is:
questions.solution:
Given √x - {1}{√x} = √7.
Step 1: Square to reach x + 1/x:

x + 1/x = (√7)² + 2 = 7 + 2 = 9

Step 2: Square again to reach x² + 1/x²:

x² + 1/x² = 9² - 2 = 81 - 2 = 79.
questions.trick: 2-Step Ladder: (√7)² + 2 = 9. Then 9² - 2 = 79. Done in 4 seconds!

questions.question: If x² - 2√5x + 1 = 0, then what is the value of x⁵ + 1/x⁵?
questions.trick: Power 5 combination: (x²+1/x²)(x³+1/x³) - (x+1/x).

questions.question: If x² - 4x + 4 = 0, then the value of 16(x⁴ - 1/x⁴) is:
questions.solution:
Notice x² - 4x + 4 = 0 ⟹ (x - 2)² = 0 ⟹ x = 2.
Substitute x = 2 directly into the target expression:

16(x⁴ - 1/x⁴) = 16(2⁴ - 1/2⁴) = 16(16 - 1/16)


= 16 × 16 - 16 × 1/16 = 256 - 1 = 255.
questions.trick: Perfect square root is immediate: x = 2. Multiply inside: 16(16) - 1 = 256 - 1 = 255 in 2 seconds!

questions.question: If 30x² - 15x + 1 = 0, then what is the value of 25x² + (36x²)⁻¹?
questions.solution:
Target is (5x)² + 1/6x)².
Divide given equation 30x² - 15x + 1 = 0 by 6x:

5x - 15/6 + 1/6x = 0 ⟹ 5x + 1/6x = 5/2

Square both sides:

(5x + 1/6x)² = 25x² + (1/36x²) + 2(5x)1/6x)


5/2)² = 25x² + (1/36x²) + 5/3


25x² + (1/36x²) = 25/4 - 5/3 = (75 - 20/12) = 55/12 ...

Wait, on Slide 61, Vishesh Shukla divided by 6x and calculated the exact fractional option.
questions.trick: Divide by 6x to produce the exact target linear terms (5x + 1/6x). Square and subtract 2 × 5 × 1/6.

questions.question: If x + 1/x = -2, then find the value of (x¹⁷ + {1}{x¹⁷})(x¹² - {1}{x¹²}).
questions.solution:
Maestro's Golden Rule: Whenever x + 1/x = -2 ⟹ x = -1.
Substitute x = -1:
Term 1: x¹⁷ + {1}{x¹⁷} = (-1)¹⁷ + {1}{(-1)¹⁷} = -1 - 1 = -2.
Term 2: x¹² - {1}{x¹²} = (-1)¹² - {1}{(-1)¹²} = 1 - 1 = 0.
Product = (-2) × 0 = 0!
questions.trick: When x + 1/x = -2 ⟹ x = -1. Any even power minus its reciprocal is 1 - 1 = 0. Multiplying anything by 0 gives 0 immediately!

questions.question: If 16x⁴ + 1/16x⁴ = 14159, then find the value of 2x + 1/2x.
questions.solution:
Let u = 2x. The equation is u⁴ + 1/u⁴ = 14159.
Step 1: Add 2 and take square root:

u² + (1/u²) = √14159 + 2 = √14161 = 119

Step 2: Add 2 and take square root again:

u + 1/u = √119 + 2 = √121 = 11

Since u = 2x, 2x + 1/2x = 11.
questions.trick: Reverse root ladder: 14159 ➔ (+2) ➔ √14161 = 119 ➔ (+2) ➔ √121 = 11. Done in 5 seconds!

questions.question: The value of (p-q)³ + (q-r)³ + (r-p)³/12(p-q)(q-r)(r-p), where p ≠ q ≠ r, is equal to:
questions.solution:
Let A = p - q, B = q - r, C = r - p.
Notice A + B + C = (p - q) + (q - r) + (r - p) = 0.
Identity: When A + B + C = 0 ⟹ A³ + B³ + C³ = 3ABC.
Therefore, the numerator is 3(p - q)(q - r)(r - p).
Substituting into the expression:

(3(p-q)(q-r)(r-p)/12(p-q)(q-r)(r-p) = 3/12 = 1/4.
questions.trick: Whenever cyclic differences are cubed: numerator is 3ABC. 3ABC / (12ABC) = 3/12 = 1/4 in 2 seconds!

questions.question: If (a+b+c) = 14 and (a³+b³+c³ - 3abc) = 98, find the value of (a²+b²+c²).
questions.solution:
Use Form 4 of the Cubic Expansion:

a³+b³+c³ - 3abc = 1/2(a+b+c)[3(a²+b²+c²) - (a+b+c)²]

Substitute given values:

98 = 1/2(14)[3(a²+b²+c²) - 14²]


98 = 7[3(a²+b²+c²) - 196]

Divide by 7:

14 = 3(a²+b²+c²) - 196 ⟹ 3(a²+b²+c²) = 210 ⟹ a²+b²+c² = 70.
questions.trick: Maestro's Form 4 Rule: 98/7 = 14. Then 14 + 196 = 210, and 210 / 3 = 70!

questions.question: If (a+b-c) = 20 and a²+b²+c² = 152, find the value of a³+b³-c³ + 3abc.
questions.solution:
Let C = -c. Then the given equations become:

a + b + C = 20 and a² + b² + C² = 152

We need a³ + b³ + C³ - 3abC.
Apply Form 4:

a³+b³+C³ - 3abC = 1/2(a+b+C)[3(a²+b²+C²) - (a+b+C)²]


= 1/2(20)[3(152) - 20²] = 10[456 - 400] = 10 × 56 = 560.

questions.question: If a+b+c = 5, a³+b³+c³ = 85, and abc = 25, then find the value of a²+b²+c² - ab - bc - ca.
questions.solution:
Use the fundamental expansion:

a³+b³+c³ - 3abc = (a+b+c)(a²+b²+c² - ab - bc - ca)

Calculate the left-hand side:

a³+b³+c³ - 3abc = 85 - 3(25) = 85 - 75 = 10

Now divide by (a+b+c) = 5:

a²+b²+c² - ab - bc - ca = 10/5 = 2.
questions.trick: LHS = 85 - 75 = 10. Target = 10 / 5 = 2. Done in 3 seconds!

questions.question: If p = 8.15, q = 9.06, and r = -17.21, then the value of p³+q³+r³ - 3pqr is:
questions.solution:
Check the sum of the variables:

p + q + r = 8.15 + 9.06 + (-17.21) = 17.21 - 17.21 = 0

Maestro's Golden Conditional Identity: If p + q + r = 0, then p³+q³+r³ - 3pqr = 0 identically.
questions.trick: Sum = 8.15 + 9.06 - 17.21 = 0 ⟹ Expression = 0 immediately!

questions.question: If x+y+z = 18, xyz = 81, and xy+yz+zx = 90, then find the value of ∜(x³+y³+z³ + xyz).
questions.solution:
Step 1: Calculate x³+y³+z³ - 3xyz using Form 3:

x³+y³+z³ - 3xyz = (x+y+z)[(x+y+z)² - 3(xy+yz+zx)]


= 18[18² - 3(90)] = 18[324 - 270] = 18 × 54 = 972

Step 2: Add 4xyz to both sides to get the required expression:

x³+y³+z³ + xyz = 972 + 4xyz = 972 + 4(81) = 972 + 324 = 1296

Step 3: Take the 4th root:

∜(1296) = ∜(6⁴) = 6.

questions.question: Simplify the expression: (a² - 4b²)³ + 64(b² - 4c²)³ + (16c² - a²)³/(a - 2b)³ + (2b - 4c)³ + (4c - a)³).
questions.solution:
Rewrite numerator terms:

(a² - 4b²)³ + (4b² - 16c²)³ + (16c² - a²)³

Notice (a² - 4b²) + (4b² - 16c²) + (16c² - a²) = 0. Since sum = 0, the sum of cubes is 3ABC:

Num = 3(a² - 4b²)(4b² - 16c²)(16c² - a²)


= 3(a-2b)(a+2b) · 4(b-2c)(b+2c) · (4c-a)(4c+a)


= 12(a-2b)(a+2b)(b-2c)(b+2c)(4c-a)(4c+a)

Now denominator: (a-2b) + (2b-4c) + (4c-a) = 0.

Den = 3(a-2b)(2b-4c)(4c-a) = 3 × 2(a-2b)(b-2c)(4c-a) = 6(a-2b)(b-2c)(4c-a)

Divide numerator by denominator:

(12(a+2b)(b+2c)(4c+a)/6) = 2(a+2b)(b+2c)(4c+a).
questions.trick: Maestro's Ratio of Products: Numerator factor is 3(1)(4)(1) = 12. Denominator factor is 3(1)(2)(1) = 6. Ratio = 12/6 = 2 with plus signs!

questions.question: If x - y = 4 and x³ - y³ = 316, y > 0, then the value of x⁴ - y⁴ is:
questions.solution:
Step 1: Expand x³ - y³:

x³ - y³ = (x-y)[(x-y)² + 3xy] ⟹ 316 = 4[16 + 3xy] ⟹ 79 = 16 + 3xy ⟹ xy = 21

Step 2: Solve system x - y = 4 and xy = 21:
Factors of 21 differing by 4 are 7 and 3. Thus x = 7, y = 3.
Step 3: Calculate x⁴ - y⁴:

x⁴ - y⁴ = 7⁴ - 3⁴ = 2401 - 81 = 2320.
questions.trick: Hit & Trial: xy = 21 and x - y = 4 ⟹ x = 7, y = 3. Value = 7⁴ - 3⁴ = 2401 - 81 = 2320 in 5 seconds!

questions.question: If (3x-1)³ + (4x-3)³ + (2x+1)³ = 3(3x-1)(4x-3)(2x+1) and x ≠ 1/2, then x =
questions.solution:
Identity: If A³ + B³ + C³ = 3ABC and A ≠ B ≠ C, then A + B + C = 0.
Here A = 3x-1, B = 4x-3, C = 2x+1.
Sum:

(3x - 1) + (4x - 3) + (2x + 1) = 0


9x - 3 = 0 ⟹ 9x = 3 ⟹ x = 1/3.
questions.trick: Equate the sum of bases to 0: 3x - 1 + 4x - 3 + 2x + 1 = 9x - 3 = 0 ⟹ x = 1/3.

questions.question: If x = 110, y = 111, z = 112, then find the value of x³+y³+z³ - 3xyz.
questions.solution:
Notice that 110, 111, 112 form an Arithmetic Progression with middle term y = 111 and common difference d = 1.
Maestro's Golden AP Shortcut:

x³+y³+z³ - 3xyz = 9 × (middle term) × d²


= 9 × 111 × 1² = 999.
questions.trick: Maestro's 9 · b · d² Rule: 9 × 111 × 1² = 999. Direct mental math in 2 seconds!

questions.question: If a = 2022, b = 2021, and c = 2020, then the value of a²+b²+c² - ab - bc - ca is:
questions.solution:
The numbers 2020, 2021, 2022 are in AP with common difference d = 1.
Maestro's Golden AP Formula for Symmetric Squares:

a²+b²+c² - ab - bc - ca = 3d²


= 3(1)² = 3.
questions.trick: Maestro's 3d² Rule: Difference between consecutive terms is d = 1. Answer = 3(1)² = 3. Zero calculations needed!

questions.question: If a²+b²+c² = ab+bc+ca, then the value of (11a⁴ + 13b⁴ + 17c⁴/17a²b² + 9b²c² + 15c²a²) is:
questions.solution:
The condition a²+b²+c² - ab - bc - ca = 0 ⟺ 1/2[(a-b)² + (b-c)² + (c-a)²] = 0 ⟺ a = b = c.
Let a = b = c = 1:
Numerator = 11(1) + 13(1) + 17(1) = 41.
Denominator = 17(1) + 9(1) + 15(1) = 41.
Value = 41/41 = 1.
questions.trick: Condition implies a = b = c. Put a = b = c = 1 ⟹ (11+13+17/17+9+15) = 41/41 = 1 in 2 seconds!

questions.type: Type 3: Sum of Squares & Symmetric Systems
questions.question: If (a+b+c) = 19 and (a²+b²+c²) = 155, find the value of (a-b)² + (b-c)² + (c-a)².
questions.solution:
Identity: (a-b)² + (b-c)² + (c-a)² = 3(a²+b²+c²) - (a+b+c)².
Substitute the given values:

= 3(155) - 19² = 465 - 361 = 104.
questions.trick: Maestro's Direct Expression: 3(a²+b²+c²) - (a+b+c)² = 3(155) - 361 = 465 - 361 = 104.

questions.type: Type 3: Sum of Squares & Symmetric Systems
questions.question: If 4(x+7)(2x-1) = Ax² + Bx + C, then the value of A+B+C is:
questions.solution:
Notice that the sum of coefficients A+B+C is obtained by simply evaluating the polynomial at x = 1:

A(1)² + B(1) + C = 4(1+7)(2(1)-1)


A+B+C = 4(8)(1) = 32.
questions.trick: Topper Trick for Sum of Coefficients: Always put x = 1! 4(8)(1) = 32 without expanding any brackets!

questions.type: Type 3: Sum of Squares & Symmetric Systems
questions.question: If x - y + z = 0, then find the value of (x²/2yz) - (y²/2zx) + (z²/2xy).
questions.solution:
Take common denominator 2xyz:

(x³ - y³ + z³/2xyz)

Let Y = -y. Then x + Y + z = 0 ⟹ x³ + Y³ + z³ = 3xYz = 3x(-y)z = -3xyz.
Numerator is x³ - y³ + z³ = -3xyz.
Substitute back:

(-3xyz/2xyz) = -3/2.
questions.trick: Value putting: Put x = 1, z = 1 ⟹ y = 2. Numerator = 1³ - 2³ + 1³ = 1 - 8 + 1 = -6. Denominator = 2(1)(2)(1) = 4. Ratio = -6/4 = -3/2.

questions.type: Type 3: Sum of Squares & Symmetric Systems
questions.question: If x² + 8y² - 12y - 4xy + 9 = 0, then the value of (7x - 8y) is:
questions.solution:
Split 8y² = 4y² + 4y² to complete two perfect squares:

(x² - 4xy + 4y²) + (4y² - 12y + 9) = 0


(x - 2y)² + (2y - 3)² = 0

Since sum of squares is 0, each bracket must be 0:

2y - 3 = 0 ⟹ y = 3/2


x - 2y = 0 ⟹ x = 2y = 23/2) = 3

Now calculate 7x - 8y:

7(3) - 83/2) = 21 - 12 = 9.
questions.trick: Complete squares: 2y = 3 ⟹ y = 1.5, x = 3. Value = 7(3) - 8(1.5) = 21 - 12 = 9.

questions.type: Type 3: Sum of Squares & Symmetric Systems
questions.question: If a²+b²+c² + 96 = 8(a+b-2c), then √ab - bc + ca is equal to:
questions.solution:
Bring all terms to the left side:

(a² - 8a) + (b² - 8b) + (c² + 16c) + 96 = 0

Complete squares:

(a - 4)² - 16 + (b - 4)² - 16 + (c + 8)² - 64 + 96 = 0


(a - 4)² + (b - 4)² + (c + 8)² = 0

Since sum of squares is 0:

a = 4, b = 4, c = -8

Calculate ab - bc + ca:

ab - bc + ca = 4(4) - 4(-8) + (-8)(4) = 16 + 32 - 32 = 16


√16 = 4.
questions.trick: Maestro's Vertex Shortcut: a = 8/2 = 4, b = 8/2 = 4, c = -16/2 = -8. Target = √16 + 32 - 32 = √16 = 4.

questions.type: Type 3: Sum of Squares & Symmetric Systems
questions.question: If x+y+z = 0, then find the value of (x²/x²-yz) + (y²/y²-zx) + (z²/z²-xy).
questions.solution:
Use Value Putting Strategy (1 equation, 3 variables ⟹ 2 degrees of freedom).
Put z = 0.
Then x + y = 0 ⟹ y = -x. Let x = 1, y = -1.
Substitute into the expression:
Term 1: (1²/1² - (-1)(0) = 1/1 = 1.
Term 2: (-1)²/(-1)² - (1)(0) = 1/1 = 1.
Term 3: (0²/0² - (1)(-1) = 0/1 = 0.
Sum = 1 + 1 + 0 = 2.
questions.trick: Maestro's Zero Substitution: Set z = 0 ⟹ x = 1, y = -1. Instant result 1 + 1 + 0 = 2 in 3 seconds!

questions.type: Type 3: Sum of Squares & Symmetric Systems
questions.question: If x² + 4y² + 3z² + 2 = 2√3(x + y + z), then the value of (x - 4y + 3z) is:
questions.trick: Maestro's Vertex Rule: x = √3, y = √3/4, z = √3/3. Then √3 - √3 + √3 = √3 directly!

questions.question: If 8a³ + 27b³ = 16 and 2a + 3b = 4, then find the value of 16a⁴ + 81b⁴.
questions.solution:
Let X = 2a and Y = 3b.
Given: X + Y = 4 and X³ + Y³ = 16.
Step 1: Find XY:

X³ + Y³ = (X+Y)[(X+Y)² - 3XY] ⟹ 16 = 4[16 - 3XY] ⟹ 4 = 16 - 3XY ⟹ 3XY = 12 ⟹ XY = 4

Step 2: Find X² + Y²:

X² + Y² = (X+Y)² - 2XY = 4² - 2(4) = 16 - 8 = 8

Step 3: Calculate 16a⁴ + 81b⁴ = X⁴ + Y⁴:

X⁴ + Y⁴ = (X²+Y²)² - 2(XY)² = 8² - 2(4²) = 64 - 32 = 32.
questions.trick: Transform X=2a, Y=3b. XY = 4. X²+Y² = 8. X⁴+Y⁴ = 8² - 2(16) = 64 - 32 = 32.

questions.question: If (x+y)³ - (x-y)³ - 3y(2x² - 3y²) = ky³, then find the value of k.
questions.solution:
Expand each part:

(x+y)³ - (x-y)³ = (x³+3x²y+3xy²+y³) - (x³-3x²y+3xy²-y³) = 6x²y + 2y³

Subtract 3y(2x² - 3y²) = 6x²y - 9y³:

(6x²y + 2y³) - (6x²y - 9y³) = 2y³ + 9y³ = 11y³

Comparing with ky³ ⟹ k = 11.
questions.trick: Maestro's Zero-Variable Substitution: Put x = 0, y = 1! (1)³ - (-1)³ - 3(1)(-3) = 1 + 1 + 9 = 11 = k(1)³ ⟹ k = 11 in 3 seconds!

questions.question: If (5√5x³ - 81√3y³) ÷ (√5x - 3√3y) = (Ax² + By² + Cxy), then the value of (6A + B - √15C) is:
If 2x² + y² + 6x - 2xy + 9 = 0, then what is the value of y²?
questions.solution:
Rearrange into sum of squares:

(x² - 2xy + y²) + (x² + 6x + 9) = 0


(x - y)² + (x + 3)² = 0

Since both are real squares:

x + 3 = 0 ⟹ x = -3


x - y = 0 ⟹ y = x = -3

Thus y² = (-3)² = 9.
questions.trick: Split squares: (x-y)² + (x+3)² = 0 ⟹ x = -3, y = -3. Target = y² = (-3)² = 9.

questions.question: If 6√6p³ + 2√2q³ = (√6p + √2q)(Sp² + Mq² - Npq), then the positive value of √S² + M² + 2N² is:
questions.solution:
Express as a³ + b³:

(√6p)³ + (√2q)³ = (√6p + √2q)[(√6p)² + (√2q)² - (√6p)(√2q)]


= (√6p + √2q)[6p² + 2q² - √12pq]

Comparing with (Sp² + Mq² - Npq):

S = 6, M = 2, N = √12 = 2√3

Calculate √S² + M² + 2N²:

√6² + 2² + 2(12) = √36 + 4 + 24 = √64 = 8.

questions.question: If x = 3y + 4, then what is the value of (x³ - 27y³ - 36xy)?
questions.solution:
Rewrite as x - 3y = 4.
Cube both sides:

(x - 3y)³ = 4³


x³ - (3y)³ - 3(x)(3y)(x - 3y) = 64


x³ - 27y³ - 9xy(4) = 64


x³ - 27y³ - 36xy = 64.
questions.trick: Maestro's Free Variable Trick: Put y = 0 ⟹ x = 4. Expression = 4³ - 0 - 0 = 64 in 2 seconds!

questions.question: If (x² + y²)³ = (x³ + y³)², then the value of x/y + y/x, where x ≠ 0, y ≠ 0, is:
questions.solution:
Expand both sides:

(x² + y²)³ = x⁶ + y⁶ + 3x²y²(x² + y²)


(x³ + y³)² = x⁶ + y⁶ + 2x³y³

Equating both sides:

x⁶ + y⁶ + 3x²y²(x² + y²) = x⁶ + y⁶ + 2x³y³


3x²y²(x² + y²) = 2x³y³

Divide both sides by x²y²:

3(x² + y²) = 2xy ⟹ (x² + y²/xy) = 2/3


x/y + y/x = 2/3.
questions.trick: Cancel x⁶ + y⁶ from both sides: 3x²y²(x²+y²) = 2x³y³ ⟹ (x²+y²/xy) = 2/3.

questions.question: If 4√3x² + 5x - 2√3 = (Ax + 2)(Bx + C), then what is the value of (A + B + C) for A > 0?
questions.solution:
Factorize 4√3x² + 5x - 2√3:
Product of coefficients = 4√3 × (-2√3) = -24.
Two numbers with product -24 and sum 5 are 8 and -3.

4√3x² + 8x - 3x - 2√3 = 4x(√3x + 2) - √3(√3x + 2) = (4x - √3)(√3x + 2)

Comparing with (Ax + 2)(Bx + C):

(Ax + 2) = (√3x + 2) ⟹ A = √3


(Bx + C) = (4x - √3) ⟹ B = 4, C = -√3

Calculate A + B + C:

A + B + C = √3 + 4 + (-√3) = 4.
questions.trick: Factoring: (√3x + 2)(4x - √3). Here A = √3, B = 4, C = -√3. Sum = 4 immediately!

questions.question: If 8x³ - 27y³ = (Ax + By)(Cx² - Dy² + 6xy), then (A + B + C - D) is equal to:
questions.solution:
Factorize 8x³ - 27y³ using a³ - b³ = (a - b)(a² + b² + ab):

(2x - 3y)(4x² + 9y² + 6xy)

Compare with (Ax + By)(Cx² - Dy² + 6xy):

A = 2, B = -3, C = 4, -D = 9 ⟹ D = -9

Calculate A + B + C - D:

A + B + C - D = 2 + (-3) + 4 - (-9) = 3 + 9 = 12.
questions.trick: Careful with the negative sign! -Dy² = +9y² ⟹ D = -9. Then A+B+C-D = 2 - 3 + 4 - (-9) = 3 + 9 = 12.

questions.question: If 27(x+y)³ - 8(x-y)³ = (x + 5y)(Ax² + By² + Cxy), then what is the value of (A + B - C)?
questions.solution:
Let u = 3(x+y) = 3x+3y and v = 2(x-y) = 2x-2y.
Then u³ - v³ = (u - v)(u² + uv + v²).
Check u - v = (3x+3y) - (2x-2y) = x + 5y (matches!).
Now expand u² + uv + v²:

u² = 9(x+y)² = 9x² + 18xy + 9y²


uv = 6(x² - y²) = 6x² - 6y²


v² = 4(x-y)² = 4x² - 8xy + 4y²

Summing coefficients:

x²: 9 + 6 + 4 = 19 ⟹ A = 19


y²: 9 - 6 + 4 = 7 ⟹ B = 7


xy: 18 - 8 = 10 ⟹ C = 10

Calculate A + B - C:

A + B - C = 19 + 7 - 10 = 16.
questions.trick: Sum of squared coefficients: A = 9+6+4=19, B = 9-6+4=7, C = 18-8=10. Target = 19 + 7 - 10 = 16.

questions.question: If x² + y² = 280 and xy = 120, then find the value of (x+y/x-y).
questions.solution:
Step 1: Calculate (x+y)²:

(x+y)² = x² + y² + 2xy = 280 + 2(120) = 280 + 240 = 520

Step 2: Calculate (x-y)²:

(x-y)² = x² + y² - 2xy = 280 - 2(120) = 280 - 240 = 40

Step 3: Divide both:

(x+y/x-y)² = 520/40 = 13

Taking square root:

(x+y/x-y) = √13.
questions.trick: Maestro's Ratio of Squares: (x²+y²+2xy/x²+y²-2xy) = (280+240/280-240) = 520/40 = 13. Take square root ⟹ √13 in 3 seconds!

questions.type: Type 5: Special Powers, Factors & High-Degree Equations
questions.question: The factors of x² + 4y² + 4y - 4xy - 2x - 8 are:
questions.solution:
Notice that x² - 4xy + 4y² = (x - 2y)².
And the remaining linear terms are -2x + 4y = -2(x - 2y).
Let u = (x - 2y).
The expression becomes a simple quadratic in u:

u² - 2u - 8

Factorize:

u² - 2u - 8 = (u - 4)(u + 2)

Substitute back u = x - 2y:

(x - 2y - 4)(x - 2y + 2).
questions.trick: Look at (x-2y)² - 2(x-2y) - 8. Factors of -8 with sum -2 are -4 and +2. Thus (x-2y-4)(x-2y+2)!

questions.type: Type 5: Special Powers, Factors & High-Degree Equations
questions.question: If x² + y² + 2y + 4x + 5 = 0, then find the value of (x+y/x-y).
questions.solution:
Rearrange into sum of squares:

(x² + 4x + 4) + (y² + 2y + 1) = 0


(x + 2)² + (y + 1)² = 0

Since sum of squares is 0:

x + 2 = 0 ⟹ x = -2


y + 1 = 0 ⟹ y = -1

Calculate (x+y/x-y):

(-2 + (-1)/-2 - (-1) = (-3/-2 + 1) = (-3/-1) = 3.
questions.trick: Zero sum of squares: x = -2, y = -1. Ratio = (-2-1/-2-(-1) = (-3/-1) = 3.

questions.type: Type 5: Special Powers, Factors & High-Degree Equations
questions.question: If x² + 4y² + 2x + 1 = 0, then find the value of x⁹⁹ + y⁹⁹.
questions.solution:
Rearrange:

(x² + 2x + 1) + 4y² = 0


(x + 1)² + (2y)² = 0

Since both terms are perfect squares:

x + 1 = 0 ⟹ x = -1


2y = 0 ⟹ y = 0

Evaluate x⁹⁹ + y⁹⁹:

(-1)⁹⁹ + 0⁹⁹ = -1 + 0 = -1.
questions.trick: Perfect squares: x = -1, y = 0. Since 99 is odd, (-1)⁹⁹ = -1.
